content: Nakabsilamaw

Kalin nuwag yakamiy, min-Pilipay yakamiy tayakelesiys Yeisuw Kelis waseg, simiyas mituwa̱veks o mitulals. Milet neiw kukines. Yey Pawl soug Timotiy, Yeisuw Kelis natouwat yakamey. DaGuyaws Yeisuw Kelis son Tamads Yowbad bisiwyoubumiy va̱gan beitaw nuwamiy.
Pawl initoug pines tasiyas
Aninuweimiy amisinap bwanabwein, mapuna ikalin nuwag Yowbad waseg.
Tut babaw nanoug ibwein wasigeis yakamiy, mapuna aninitoug pinamiy yakamiy; peinan nukulabeigs Yeisuw nawotet waseg, tut wanmugwana ma̱wana ee... nagein gog bo ma̱wan.
Akakin-wan Yowbad biyakous amisinap bwanabwein, peinan bo isilamaw nawotet towen. Igaw mo biyakous, tutan Yeisuw Kelis beiyum beim.
Bweina baninuweimiy amibabaw, peinan akalpwa̱kit wasigeis yakamiy. Peinan nukulabeigs wa̱deil nases, o nitageiguys liva̱nen Yeisuw, o gamag babaw niliganes, peinan Yowbad nisiwyoubuds.
Yowbad ikakin, singay ikalin nuwag wasigeis yakamiy, Yeisuw Kelis nasiwa̱youb waseg.
Gunakanitoug ma̱wana silma̱nin bukusiwa̱youbs beibwein, o bikamnat ninoumiy va̱gan bukukwakins sinap bwanabwein. Igaw tutan Kelis beiyum beim mo beivag amisinap kamnat didumwal.
E, Yeisuw Kelis bikatimweis bibabaw anagin amisinap bwanabwein, mo bitakavasis Yowbad o bitakatubaws Yowbad waseg.
Silawun mwamovag Kelis waseg
Sigwey, sivinag bukukwakins mouvitan Kelis nalivet, tage babaw gamag mo iliganes liva̱nen Kelis, isimounids waseg.
Mina-Lom tasiyas takannaviy sisiyas touwos ikakins yey ases wa̱deil, peinan Kelis angamag yey.
O peinan yey wa̱deil nases, tasiyas tayakelesiys daGuyaws waseg kalamwey babaw bo ikapwapouts, aspwa̱yat bo ikous, mo illivans liva̱nen Yowbad.

Gamag mwasanin dibes imouvit waseg yey mo igeiguys liva̱nen Kelis, tage nag sivines bilabeigs. Mwasanin gog igeiguys siwa̱youb waseg, ikakins yey ases wa̱deil peinan aysiyous liva̱nen Kelis; idokes kid bilabeigs.
Bwein-wan. Peinan igeiguys liva̱nen Kelis. Mapuna amwa̱saw, takinew bigeiguys wudous mav waseg, o takinew bigeiguys son ninous waseg.
Amwa̱saw-wan. Akakin-vak kuninitougs peinag yey, kululuwan Yeisuw Kelis mo bilabeig, wankuyeim mo bilikugs.

Asimounid peinan anamis Kelis bilabeig va̱gan nag ba̱gwey; tage ma̱wan kweiboug Kelis nakaleiwag waseg akapwapout, tut babaw bo ma̱wan-wan, va̱gan gamag bikavasis Kelis, takinew son mwamovag bases, o takinew bakanig.
Kukin sona mwamovag bases, Kelis waseg yey bisesun-wan, o bamwa̱saw. Kukin gog bakanig, banek Kelis, mo singay bamwa̱saw.

Kukin son mwamovag basesun-wan mo beivag anagin gunawotet. Tage nag akakin aveiyag bakamkwin, peinan ked akweiy sivinag-wan. Singay sivinag balisaweimiy banek Kelis; kukin gog basesuna ven watinow mo balabeimiy yakamiy.

Akakin-wan bweina bases wasigeis yakamiy, va̱gan bayamweis mitapwa̱loul bitawtoun, sona mimwa̱saw. Akakin-wan igaw mo baw balakwaneimiy balabeimiy, va̱gan gog bikalin nuwamiy, bukuya̱kawns Yeisuw Kelis waseg.

Kadiloka Kelis ansinap bibunakeimiy, peinan tanganegs liva̱nen Kelis yakamiy. Takinew baw o nag, tage ivag sivinag baligen bulagan amisinap bwanabwein, peinan kwativases ninoumiy imlavag katanok-wan, mo kutawtouns silma̱nin Kelis natapwa̱loul bwanabwein.
Awoum kuwenes tasiyas tasilbwadeimiy; awoum. Tasiyas bikineimiy ta-ivag amipwa̱yat, mo bikakins Yowbad bo bikatinabweimiy yakamiy, tasiyas gog mo biyagages.

Yowbad bo ikalawageimiy va̱gan bukusimounids Kelis waseg, o abamiy-vak bigeg Kelis peinan. Kweiboug bukukineigs avvatay sinap kalbaleb waseg, mapuna a̱bag igeg o nagein liva̱neig nukuliganes ma̱wan; e yakamiy-vak abamiy bigeg peinan kuvvatays sinap kalbaleb waseg.
